title: Character Background
description: A comprehensive schema for character backgrounds with narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the background.

background_type.description: The primary category of the background.

era.description: The primary era this background is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM (Genesis Protocol Article II): Static tags that define this background's themes and social connections. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml. Examples: ['soldier', 'military_training', 'disciplined', 'tactical'].

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the background, its significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this background.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this background is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: The main descriptive text for the background, providing comprehensive details.

life_experience.description: Detailed description of the typical life experiences and challenges faced by someone with this background.

common_origins.description: Common places or circumstances where people with this background originate.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Common Among', 'Natural Path To', 'Associated With', 'Trained By', 'Served In'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this background from Star Wars canon.

famous_individuals.description: Notable individuals who have this background.

famous_events.description: Notable events or moments involving people with this background.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this background.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this background.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this background.

typical_missions.description: Types of missions or tasks typically associated with this background.

cultural_impact.description: How this background affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

social_standing.description: The typical social standing and reputation of people with this background.

proficiencies.description: Skills, tools, and languages granted by this background.

skills.description: Skill proficiencies granted by this background.

tools.description: Tool proficiencies, including fixed and choice-based options.

languages.description: Language proficiencies, including fixed and choice-based options.

feature.description: The unique feature granted by this background, reusing our feature schema.

personality_options.description: Lists of choices for the player to define their character's personality.

traits.description: Personality traits commonly associated with this background.

ideals.description: Core beliefs and values commonly held by people with this background.

bonds.description: Important relationships and connections commonly formed by people with this background.

flaws.description: Common weaknesses and character flaws associated with this background.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this background, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this background adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Location', 'Item').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this background is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the background's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the background's icon for UI display.

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this background.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this background.
